verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation of employer tasks such as quarterly tax-and-wage filing is a fair question for an agency running a transactional portal (EAMS/eServices), so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive online filing behind SecureAccess Washington login, paper and PDF alternatives, and probes finding no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or markdown docs. There is no documented API, CLI, bulk-upload automation path, or CI-usable interface.
